title: One-step compatibility of the split counter
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S,H$ be types, let $emb:S\to H$ and $ret:\mathrm{Bool}\to H$, let $w,s$ be Boolean words, let $c$ be a configuration over the empty input with $k$ work tapes, and let $a$ be a one-step action for that configuration. Applying the lifted action to the associated counter configuration gives exactly the counter configuration associated with the result of applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: w and s are Boolean words
c is a configuration over Bool on empty input
a is an action over Bool with k work tapes and states S
